description: Replace SkillsLive ingestion filesystem invokes with Storage/Disk data-source events for volume listing, uploads, resource listing, and deletion. Cover resource upload/list/delete and disabled Disk config behavior.

comments.text: Moved Skills resource operations off legacy Ingestion invoke calls. SkillsLive now dispatches Disk data-source actions through NodeRouter/Channels, with @resource_data_source_provider "disk" isolated for future runtime config. Tests use DiskBridge-backed data-source events.

title: [zaq-8o8] Move Skills resources off Ingestion filesystem API
